_meta.description: D6 fixtures for google-antigravity / gen-ui-open (open-gen-ui demo). Each pill emits a generateSandboxedUi tool call that the demo renders in a sandboxed iframe.
_meta.googleAntigravityStaging: Staged on turnIndex, not hasToolResult: the Antigravity Go harness never sends role:"tool" messages (see PARITY_NOTES.md). 0 = the tool call, 2 = narration after the frontend handler answers.

fixtures._comment: open-gen-ui pill '3D axis visualization (model airplane)' — generateSandboxedUi frontend tool call; the frontend handler answers 'UI generated' and the runtime's OpenGenerativeUIMiddleware mounts the sandboxed iframe.
